description: Maps SDV artifacts to virtual-phase entities for automation handoff.

bindings.purpose: Uses SDV network rules as authoritative source for virtual setup defaults.
Inventory IP rows for workload and ephemeral nodes must stay inside allocatable range.
Runtime bridge/veth topology in matrix is realized by hum-dev-netns script commands.
Location and encrypted cloud service nodes are represented in the logical virtual matrix for automation handoff.
Optional MACsec lab feature should be enabled only when state and key material are present.
Mint bind-bridge tokens from amd64 ISOs, Darwin kernel.dmg, and other present ISO files to connect laptop/penguin to the desktop server area.

Run the bind-bridge under snapper-timeline.service or snapperd.service with fwupd.service TCP/UDP, keeping phpsessionclean.service and apt-listchanges.service off the path. Bound plymouth-quit-wait.service so its infinite wait cannot hold the field; Perl apt-listchanges stays Conflicts=.
